24. Stateful vs Stateless
Authentication

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Stateful sessions consult server-side login state; stateless access tokens can be verified locally,
but renewal/revocation may add state.
සිංහJලෙන් Stateful session එකට server store lookup අවශ්‍යයි. Stateless JWT signature සහ claims check
කරලා request එක validate කරන්න පුළුවන්; refresh සහ revoke සඳහා state නැවත අවශ්‍ය විය
A web dashboard uses Redis sessions; distributed APIs use signed short-lived access tokens.

Expected result: Both approaches authenticate valid requests; revocation behavior differs.

Which scales better? Both can scale; choose based on architecture, revocation and operational
